from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find bar: full row or column of one uniform color != bg
    bar=None  # ('v',col) or ('h',row), color
    for j in range(w):
        col={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(col)==1 and next(iter(col))!=bg:
            bar=('v',j,next(iter(col)))
    for i in range(h):
        row=set(g[i])
        if len(row)==1 and next(iter(row))!=bg and (bar is None or bar[2]!=next(iter(row)) or True):
            pass
    hbar=None
    for i in range(h):
        row=set(g[i])
        if len(row)==1 and next(iter(row))!=bg:
            hbar=('h',i,next(iter(row)))
    obj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,)]
    if bar:
        _,bc,bcol=bar
        obj=[(i,j) for i,j in obj if j!=bc]
    if hbar:
        _,hr,hcol=hbar
        obj=[(i,j) for i,j in obj if i!=hr]
    LC=8
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    if bar:  # vertical bar -> vertical line
        cols=[j for _,j in obj]
        lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
        if bc>hi:
            line=hi+1 if hi+1<bc else lo-1
        else:
            line=lo-1 if lo-1>bc else hi+1
        for i in range(h): out[i][line]=LC
    else:    # horizontal bar -> horizontal line
        rows=[i for i,_ in obj]
        lo,hi=min(rows),max(rows)
        if hr>hi:
            line=hi+1 if hi+1<hr else lo-1
        else:
            line=lo-1 if lo-1>hr else hi+1
        for j in range(w): out[line][j]=LC
    return out

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    vbar=[(j,next(iter({g[i][j] for i in range(h)}))) for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and g[0][j]!=bg]
    hbar=[(i,next(iter(set(g[i])))) for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=bg]
    obj=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in {(i,j) for i,_ in hbar} and (i,j) not in {(i,j) for j,_ in vbar}]
    LC=8
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    if vbar:
        bc,_=vbar[0]
        cols=[j for _,j in obj]; lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
        if bc>hi: shift=bc-1-hi   # move object right to touch bar
        elif bc<lo: shift=bc+1-lo
        else: shift=0
        newobj=set((i,j+shift) for i,j in obj)
        for i,j in obj: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newobj: out[i][j]=g[i][j]
        line=(min(j for _,j in newobj)-1) if bc>hi else (max(j for _,j in newobj)+1)
        for i in range(h): out[i][line]=LC
    else:
        hr,_=hbar[0]
        rows=[i for i,_ in obj]; lo,hi=min(rows),max(rows)
        if hr>hi: shift=hr-1-hi
        elif hr<lo: shift=hr+1-lo
        else: shift=0
        newobj=set((i+shift,j) for i,j in obj)
        for i,j in obj: out[i][j]=bg
        for i,j in newobj: out[i][j]=g[i][j]
        line=(min(i for i,_ in newobj)-1) if hr>hi else (max(i for i,_ in newobj)+1)
        for j in range(w): out[line][j]=LC
